summary: Introduces tags for running or skipping parts of a large playbook: add tags to tasks (directly or via inheritance), then select or skip them at runtime. Tags are processed early with high precedence.
questions: How do I run only part of a playbook?
How do tags work in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Using tags to run part of a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
Two steps:
1. Add tags to tasks, directly or by inheritance from a block, play, role or import.
2. Select or skip tags when you run the playbook.

Tags are evaluated during pre-processing and take high precedence in deciding which tasks run.
